preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have compromised the owner's private key)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setMaxTxPercent(0) to set _maxTxAmount to zero. This will cause all transfers from non-owner addresses to fail because the require(amount <= _maxTxAmount) check in _transfer() will revert for any positive amount. The owner can still transfer tokens since the check is skipped when sender == owner().
